remarks: Elegant End-Unit Townhouse with Private Entrance!! This beautifully updated tri-level townhouse offers 2 spacious bedrooms, each featuring their own full bath, and stylish upgrades throughout, including modernized bathrooms, flooring, and fixtures. Flooded with natural light, the home features a wood-burning fireplace, 1st floor powder room, a private deck with serene views, and the rare benefit of a private entrance-an exclusive feature not found in every unit. Additional highlights include a newer hot water heater and the privacy of an end-unit location. Situated in a sought-after complex with two pools, clubhouse, gym and recently enhanced tennis and pickleball courts, this townhouse combines comfort, convenience, and a bright, inviting atmosphere. Highest and best Monday 4pm.
